notes.title: The Park is now out on Nintendo Switch, just in time for Halloween.
notes.notes:
The Park provides a short, but intense story-driven psychological horror. Set in Atlantic Island Park after closing hours, you assume the role of Lorraine, in search for her son Callum. His quest to find his missing teddy bear has led him on a path on which you will discover that this place is haunted by tragedy and drama. The amusement park has a history of freak accidents and grotesque killings, and locals worry it is far from done claiming innocent lives… 

[b]The game is available on the [url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/the-park-switch/]Nintendo Game Store[/url] for $9.99/€9.99 (regional differences may apply). [/b]

The Nintendo Switch version of The Park is the second game to be released by Funcom this week, following the PC launch of cosmic horror game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1012840/Moons_of_Madness/]Moons of Madness[/url] on Tuesday. Both games are set in the same thematic universe as Funcom’s Secret World Legends, but playing one of the games is by no means a prerequisite to enjoy the others.

notes.title: Wot I Think: The Park
notes.notes:
The Park [official site] is a short horror game, a spin-off from Funcom’s MMORPG The Secret World [official site]. For as long as people have been talking about the modern myths and conspiracies of The Secret World, there has been a desire for a singleplayer experience set among its mysteries and horrors. The Park will not satisfy that craving – it’s a brief visit to one small self-contained area of that world – but I found it be an oddly engaging experience, warts and all, and hope it’s the first in a library of singleplayer stories.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Screampark: Secret World Spin-Off The Park Released
notes.notes:
Funcom’s latest adventure into the spooky world of The Secret World isn’t the single-player version I’ve wished for, but they are revisiting a memorable location from the supernatural MMORPG.

The Park [official site] is a spin-off horror walk-o-story set inside Atlantic Island Park, a haunted fairground where now a mother has lost her young son. Don’t get your hopes up, lady. But you, dear reader, perhaps cock an eyebrow at its spooking potential, as The Park opened its gates this afternoon.

That’s when The Secret World folks Funcom will release The Park [official site], a walk-o-spook spin-off from the supernatural MMO and their first single-player game in years.
